# My Planet Services

> High-velocity SaaS, Web, and AI Automation Development Studio building production software, headless storefronts, custom CRM/ERP engines, and generative AI systems for ambitious teams.

## Overview
My Planet Services operates as an integrated product unit: strategy, UI/UX architecture, full-stack engineering, and AI automation working in seamless agile sprints. Clients work directly with senior principal architects and engineers with zero agency bloat, 100% IP ownership, and weekly Friday demo deployments.

## Core Engineering Disciplines

1. **E-Commerce Development**: Custom headless Shopify Plus & Medusa storefronts, sub-second checkout, 3D visualizers, ERP/inventory synchronization, 98+ Core Web Vitals.
2. **Company & Corporate Websites**: Flagship digital presences, bespoke brand translation, headless CMS (Sanity, Strapi), WCAG AAA accessibility, multi-language localization.
3. **Website Redesign & Modernization**: UI/UX overhaul, 98+ PageSpeed optimization, zero SEO equity loss, modern React 19 / Next.js migration.
4. **Custom CRM & ERP Systems**: Tailored business operating engines, automated pipelines, role-based security, automated client/vendor portals.
5. **Web Applications & SaaS Platforms**: Multi-tenant architectures, scalable database schemas, Stripe/Paddle billing, real-time sync, microservices.
6. **Mobile App Development**: Cross-platform iOS & Android apps built with React Native & Flutter, offline sync, biometric auth.
7. **AI Automation & Vector Ops**: Zero-hallucination support agents, automated lead qualification, vector RAG search, internal LLM copilots.
8. **SEO, AEO & GEO Programs**: Programmatic SEO, schema.org JSON-LD entity structures for Google rich snippets, voice search, and generative answer engine citations (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini).
9. **Digital Marketing & Growth**: High-converting landing funnels, multi-channel performance creative, retention workflows, revenue analytics.

## Engagement Models

- **Launch Sprint (Fixed Scope)**: Rapid MVP delivery in 2 to 4 weeks. Ideal for founders launching a new venture or high-converting marketing system.
- **Scale Platform (Dedicated Squad)**: Monthly dedicated senior engineering pod (full-stack + AI + design). Weekly Friday demos, direct Slack channel, continuous roadmap execution.
- **Enterprise Engine (Custom Architecture Pod)**: High-security, multi-region architecture, SOC2 compliance, dedicated technical lead, 24/7 SLA.

## Guarantees & Standards

- **100% IP Ownership**: You own all source code, design systems, databases, and cloud infrastructure from day one.
- **Mutual NDA**: Strict confidentiality prior to reviewing product roadmaps or proprietary codebases.
- **Performance**: Guaranteed 95+ Core Web Vitals score on mobile and desktop.
